summary: Announces that RFC numbers can now be obtained on-line through NLS at OFFICE-1 instead of at SRI-ARC, though one can still phone the NIC. It also notes that pre-assigned journal numbers work only on the system they came from.

plainLanguage.summary: RFC 628 announces that online RFC number requests now go through NLS at OFFICE-1 rather than SRI-ARC. It also clarifies that other pre-assigned Journal numbers are limited to the system where they were obtained.

subtitle: RFC number requests move online from SRI-ARC to NLS at OFFICE-1.

tldr.problem: The location for obtaining RFC numbers online had changed.
tldr.mechanism: The memo directs users to NLS at OFFICE-1 for online requests and says they may still call the NIC instead.
tldr.outcome: Pre-assigned Journal numbers other than RFC numbers can be used through NLS only on the system from which they were obtained.

today: The unit records RFC 628's status as Unknown and lists no updates or obsoleting RFCs. It is a notice about where to obtain RFC and Journal numbers through NLS.

sections.title: Requesting an RFC Number
sections.content:
RFC numbers can now be obtained online through NLS at OFFICE-1. They can no longer be obtained online at SRI-ARC.

Users who do not want to use the online facilities may still call the NIC to obtain an RFC number.
sections.plainLanguage: Use NLS at OFFICE-1 to request an RFC number online. Calling the NIC remains another option.

sections.title: Using Pre-Assigned Journal Numbers
sections.content:
The memo distinguishes RFC numbers from other pre-assigned Journal numbers. For numbers other than RFC numbers, NLS can use a pre-assigned number only on the system where that number was obtained.

The notice does not change this restriction for the RFC-number request process described above.
sections.plainLanguage: A pre-assigned Journal number other than an RFC number works only in NLS on the system where it was taken.

sections.title: Two Ways to Obtain a Number
sections.content:
For an RFC number, the notice gives two routes: request it online through NLS at OFFICE-1 or call the NIC. The online location at SRI-ARC is no longer available for this purpose.

The memo's second point applies to pre-assigned Journal numbers other than RFC numbers: they remain usable through NLS only on the system where they were taken.
sections.plainLanguage: Request an RFC number through OFFICE-1 or by calling the NIC. Use another pre-assigned Journal number only on the system where it came from.
